title: Superps
tagline: Superps is agent-swarm intelligent perp dex which evolves over time
description: Superps is agent swarms that govern risk of perp dex positions and verified through persistent memories. We're using 0G inference and peristent memories to deploy agents with this product. After all, the memories will be compacted in simplest form to store on-chain for verifying. The memory will be chained so the agents can evolve in the future
how_its_made:
This project used 0G for the openclaw agents and uniswap v4 for creating perpetuals hook.
We're using 0G inference and peristent memories to deploy agents with this product. After all, the memories will be compacted in simplest form to store on-chain for verifying. The memory will be chained so the agents can evolve in the future
